import_provenance.original_title: Rapid cluster sampling of three-colourings on the square torus
import_provenance.original_statement: Prove a polynomial upper bound on the worst-case total-variation mixing time of Wang–Swendsen–Kotecký dynamics for uniform proper three-colourings of an N×N square torus, with N even. This would rigorously explain the sampler’s effectiveness at the critical antiferromagnetic point.
import_provenance.supplied_caveat: Remark: The July 2026 paper still lists obtaining a mixing upper bound on this torus as open; numerical observations of very fast relaxation are not a mixing-time proof.
